outcome.technical: drive-phase.py: SIGNAL_VERBS decide-gate-red-base-unknown 'judge' -> 'ask'. New unmeasurable(held) and unmeasurable_elsewhere(held, runs). base_measure_due(state, task, row, runs) now treats an unmeasurable mark taken for another red run as no mark. base_reading_for folds the background record first (base_mark), computes runs = red_runs once, and returns the row's own reading when the mark is unmeasurable and was taken elsewhere. base_run claims the launch's record with O_CREAT|O_EXCL on '<record>.claim' (claim_launch, BASE_CLAIM_SUFFIX) before the ran check; a second run gets E_USAGE naming 'pid N' and measures nothing. drop_progress also removes the claim, and claim_only=True releases it when the ran check refuses. run-test-gate.py _derived_at_base maps each named failing suite to the one path the step name lists via _ev.resolve_named (listed_by path by path). If any suite matches none, or several, the step goes in notRun with the reason. Stage runs: bi-block 14/14, bdr-block passing, bod-block 624/624. ruff exit 0, vermin 3.8 exit 0. house_style_violations, prose_number_claims and doc_prose_numbers report nothing for the changed files. outcome.descriptive: The unknown-base stop now goes to the owner as an ask. A base that could not be run no longer decides a later red, which is measured again. A derived step's base command uses the path in the step's name. Only one base-run process can claim a launch.
